# Caption Pro
> Free, private, in-browser AI captions for Hindi, Hinglish and English reels. Timeline editor, 40+ caption styles, SRT/VTT/ASS export, burned-in video, and an After Effects package.

- Live app: https://subscriptions-dot.github.io/caption-pro-live/
- Runs entirely in the browser (WebGPU Whisper). Video never leaves the device. No account, no watermark.
- Best for: reels/shorts creators, Indian-language and code-switched (Hinglish) speech, editors who finish in After Effects.
